title: About Us
intro: A small cafe with a simple idea: good coffee, honest food and a warm place to sit.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: How It All Started
paragraphs: We opened our doors with one coffee machine, four tables and a love for good conversation. Friends, students and neighbours kept coming back, and soon the cafe became a part of the neighbourhood.
Today we roast our beans every week and bake fresh every morning. Our menu is small on purpose, so we can make every cup and every plate with care.
story.imageAlt: Cafe interior with wooden tables and warm lights

values.title: Fresh Every Day
values.text: We roast in small batches and bake every morning, so nothing sits around.

values.title: Fair to Farmers
values.text: We buy from small farms and pay a fair price for their work.

values.title: A Place for Everyone
values.text: Come to work, study, meet friends or just sit quietly. You are always welcome.

ctaText: We would love to meet you. Visit us today or reserve a table for later.
